description: Approval task timeline for a given leave request process instance, sourced from SmartEngine's se_task_instance. Consumed by the wd_leave_request_detail page sub-table.
fromSql: SELECT t.process_definition_activity_id AS "nodeId", COALESCE(  (SELECT (regexp_match(def.bpmn_content, '<userTask id="' || t.process_definition_activity_id || '"[^>]*name="([^"]*)"'))[1]),  t.process_definition_activity_id) AS "taskName", COALESCE(NULLIF(u1.nick_name,''), NULLIF(u1.user_name,''), NULLIF(u2.nick_name,''), NULLIF(u2.user_name,''), t.claim_user_id) AS assignee, CASE t.status WHEN 'pending' THEN '待审批' WHEN 'completed' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'cancelled' THEN '已取消' ELSE t.status END AS status, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.details->>'comment',''), t.comment) AS comment, t.gmt_create AS "startedAt", COALESCE(t.complete_time, a.created_at) AS "completedAt" FROM se_task_instance t LEFT JOIN ab_bpm_audit_record a ON a.task_id = CAST(t.id AS VARCHAR) AND a.operation IN ('task_approve','task_reject') LEFT JOIN ab_user u1 ON t.claim_user_id IS NOT NULL AND u1.pid = t.claim_user_id LEFT JOIN ab_user u2 ON a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND u2.pid = a.user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT bpmn_content FROM ab_bpm_process_definition d   WHERE d.process_key = split_part(t.process_definition_id_and_version, ':', 1)   AND d.tenant_id = CAST(t.tenant_id AS BIGINT) AND d.status = 'deployed'   ORDER BY d.version DESC LIMIT 1) def ON TRUE WHERE t.tenant_id = CAST(#{params.tenantId} AS VARCHAR) AND t.process_instance_id = CAST(#{params.processInstanceId} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY t.gmt_create ASC
